current.text: He is a projected starter for the Knicks, next to Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
He is projected at about 31 percent usage and 35 minutes a game.
He had wrist surgery after the Finals. He was expected to be ready for opening night and looks fine.
The wrist is no concern heading into the season.
Several experts worry about a Finals hangover after two extra months of play. They expect a possible slow start, some lost production to fatigue and extra rest.

Experts disagree on how much the Knicks will rest players. One preview expects trimmed starter minutes and more rest on back-to-backs over the first 30 or so games. The newest preview says a weaker team in a stronger East may not be able to rest players as much.
He is overvalued in category leagues at his Yahoo rank of 29 and an ADP in the low 20s. Experts call taking him at 21 to 29 a mistake and see his fair category range at about picks 40 to 55.
Around pick 40 to 47 is fine for him in categories. One expert who took him at 40 later said it was probably not the best move at that spot.
In a category auction mock, an expert valued him at about 18 USD. He sold for 20 USD.
His best case in categories is about 22nd and his worst case about 91st.
The Knicks have a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Their fantasy playoff schedule is weak for a season ending March 28.
The Knicks are projected to win about 50 to 54 games.

durable.text: He is a high-usage scorer. Points are his clear strength, with good assists and good free throws.
He barely rebounds and gives almost no steals or blocks. Blocks are his weakest category, even for a guard.
He gets fewer than six free throw attempts a game. That limits how much his good FT% helps.
Experts disagree on his FG%. Some call it below average, others call it good or solid. Projections put it near league average on high volume.
He is much better in points leagues than in category leagues. Experts rate him only a modest category player compared with his reputation.

note: The market prices him at 31 USD in our league last season, 31.2 USD Yahoo average cost and 38.8 USD ESPN average cost. Category experts value him at about 18 to 20 USD, around picks 40 to 55, because his value is mostly points (z +2.1), assists and FT%, with almost no rebounds, steals or blocks. He fits punt BLK builds that want points and assists from a guard, but let someone else pay 30 USD or more. Early in the season, check his minutes and rest days after the Finals run and his recovery from wrist surgery. The Knicks' playoff schedule for our March 28 end is weak.
